question.text: A student claims that in a non-inertial (accelerating) reference frame, the only way to analyse a mechanics problem is by bringing in a pseudo force. Decide whether this claim is correct or incorrect.
conditions: the reference frame under discussion is non-inertial (accelerating)

solution.approach: A problem set in a non-inertial frame can also be solved by working entirely in an inertial frame with only real forces, so pseudo force is not the only method.

steps.text: Every non-inertial-frame problem can be solved by switching to an inertial, ground frame and using Newton's second law with only real forces, never needing a pseudo force at all.
Pseudo force is added only as a convenience, so that Newton's second law appears to hold when the calculation is done directly inside the accelerating frame.
Since the ground-frame method with real forces alone always works, the claim that pseudo force is the only way to solve such problems is false.
